independent_schedule.method: Separate Python unsigned-64 implementation using decimal constants; compared 80 complete rows against retained exact-Rust CSV and original Python JSON. No fuzzer launched.

count_semantics_review: main.rs313-324 preflights run before t0 and before aggregate Stats allocation; preflight outcomes never merge into final summary.
main.rs350-371 advances each worker own serial seed, runs scenario, then merges exactly that returned Stats.

runner.rs175-195 returns default Stats on setup failure; after successful setup sets runs=1. The latter counts even failed actions or wind-down; therefore zero failure_counts AND empty failures are required before treating final runs as successful completed prefixes.
stats.rs100-101 adds ordinary outcome runs; other Deficits.runs and tmin local run counters are distinct; no min/replay counters merge into run totals.
Scoped threads join all in-flight work after deadline. A normal final summary describes complete returned outcomes; a checkpoint or process loss is insufficient.
Empty anomalies and full final provenance/timing checks remain separately mandatory. Expected refused transactions are not invariant failures.
assumptions_and_limits: Exact authenticated binary/source/fixtures and actual launch argv must be verified at launch. Seed103410000, jobs2, all six profiles exact order, and serial worker prefixes are required.
No setup/action/wind-down failures and no anomalies. Final total must count completed ordinary outcomes; no old baseline duration is transferred.
Selection guarantee establishes no explicit per-profile counts, equal time allocation, or 24h per profile. Host choice and new run remain pending.

positions_clock_review.result: pass source review; runtime E2E remains CI evidence
positions_clock_review.clock_read: chain.ts175-179 reads signed unixTimestamp from real Clock sysvar offset32. Positive safe integer milliseconds are checked before installing.
positions_clock_review.countdown: Countdown.tsx uses nowSeconds(Date.now) and 1000 ms setInterval; passing the actual bank epoch before app.goto corrects warped bank versus host offset while preserving the countdown decrease test.
positions_clock_review.install_vs_setSystemTime: Both public methods call server _installIfNeeded which injects the same Date/timer/performance shims. Injection calls controller.resume. install sets nonfixed wall epoch and real performance elapsed advances timers and Date; setSystemTime is not a narrower Date-only replacement. No pause/fixed-time API used.
positions_clock_review.navigation: Clock API stores initialization in BrowserContext init scripts before goto; first app render uses adjusted epoch. This test owns a fresh context, so the context-wide clock change does not leak to other tests.
positions_clock_review.not_verified: No browser or validator process launched by this peer review; no product source modified.
